daily.title: Russia launches major attack on Ukraine's energy grid as winter looms
daily.summary: Emergency power cuts are in operation and some public transport systems are suspended after heavy strikes across the country.

daily.title: US appeals court pauses execution of Tennessee killer Christa Pike
daily.summary: The execution, which was halted an hour before it was scheduled to go ahead, would have been the first time a woman had been subjected to the death penalty in more than 200 years.

daily.title: 'Strong indications' Iran involved in RAF airbase incident, UK prime minister says
daily.summary: In an interview with the BBC, Andy Burnham says UK authorities "believe Iran to have played a part" in an incident that unfolded over the weekend near a vital UK air base.

daily.title: Israel to 'ramp up' aviation security after pilot 'tries to crash plane'
daily.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu says a commercial flight with 174 people on board bound for Tel Aviv had to divert to Saudi Arabia after one pilot stabbed the other and "apparently tried to crash the plane" in what is being treated in Israel as a terrorist attack.

daily.title: More than 1,000 large companies paid no tax in Australia, ATO reveals
daily.summary: Almost 30 per cent of large companies paid no tax in 2024-25, an Australian Taxation Office report reveals, resulting in the corporate tax amount payable dropping by $8.2 billion from the previous year.

daily.title: House prices plummet for sixth consecutive month as experts warn of greater falls
daily.summary: Australian house prices fell for a sixth straight month in September, and the property market is likely to continue experiencing falls of up to 15 per cent in the coming months off the back of higher interest rates and cuts to property tax breaks, experts say.

daily.title: 'Extraordinarly reckless': Prince Harry says children targeted by paparazzi
daily.summary: Prince Harry's children have been stalked by "certain European paparazzi" while at school in the English countryside, his spokesperson says, marking the latest security incident in the royal's long-running battle with media outlets.

daily.title: After 10-year probe, police want 54 people charged over Grenfell Tower blaze
daily.summary: Almost a decade since London's Grenfell Tower fire disaster, police have asked prosecutors to consider charging 54 people and 20 organisations over the blaze, which killed 72 people.

daily.title: Jai Arrow told 'nothing' about pre-grand final tribute
daily.summary: As Jai Arrow is honoured with the Provan-Summons Medal at the Dally M Awards in Sydney, he says he knows "nothing" about a tribute reportedly planned ahead of the NRL grand final on Sunday.

daily.title: Shoebridge emotional as he remembers mentor and 'bloody fun friend'
daily.summary: New Greens leader David Shoebridge gets emotional during his first interview as leader while paying tribute to his political mentor before critiquing the federal government over the cost of living.

daily.title: Couple stabbed woman in frenzied attack over love triangle, court told
daily.summary: Hannah Glover and James Sorgiovanni are accused of stabbing Busselton woman Tara Morrison multiple times before stuffing her body in a wardrobe.

daily.title: Last US-led coalition forces withdraw from Iraq after 12 years
daily.summary: This final withdrawal of troops ends a 12-year mission to fight the Islamic State group, after the US began winding down its military presence in Iraq in 2024.

daily.title: Unique gender reveal a 'blast' for mining couple who struggled with IVF
daily.summary: A WA couple who fell pregnant after 11 years of IVF celebrate their baby joy with a unique gender reveal at Kalgoorlie's Super Pit gold mine.

daily.title: Dally M 2026 red carpet: Fashion from the stars of NRL and NRLW
daily.summary: See what your favourite footballers and their dates are wearing to the NRL and NRLW's night of nights.

daily.title: Youth detention workers reach in-principle pay deal with Qld government
daily.summary: Negotiations began in early March, with the Australian Workers' Union pushing for better conditions following hundreds of reported assaults on detention centre employees over the past year.

daily.title: Garbage truck driver charged over elderly pedestrian's death
daily.summary: The driver of a rubbish truck that struck and killed an elderly man in Perth's south-east earlier this month is charged with dangerous driving.

daily.title: SA hospital pressure leading to demand 'flashpoint', union warns
daily.summary: A non-verbal man who was later diagnosed with pneumonia was ramped for more than nine hours at an outer suburbs hospital amid significant demand that the doctors union says left staff feeling "helpless".

daily.title: How a 'piece of rural propaganda' became 'compulsory listening' for Aussies
daily.summary: Blue Hills started life as "a piece of rural propaganda" to encourage World War II servicemen to "grow better crops and increase production". It ran for 27 years on ABC radio and became an institution of Australian life.

daily.title: Stawell Gift winner suspended for 12 months after positive drug test
daily.summary: Stawell Gift winner Olufemi Komolafe has been suspended from competing for 12 months following a positive drug test.

daily.title: Ex-police officer avoids conviction over 'knock and run' assault
daily.summary: A court has heard a former senior Sydney police officer's "absolutely impaired" judgement was behind his assault of two men who had played a game of "knock and run" at his home.

daily.title: Banks raise interest rates after RBA lifts cash rate to highest since 2011
daily.summary: Australia's big four banks announce interest rate rises after the Reserve Bank of Australia lifted the cash rate to its highest level in more than a decade.

daily.title: MP Luke Gosling's lawyer calls on prosecutors to drop assault charges
daily.summary: Lawyers for federal MP Luke Gosling say they will write to Sophie Callan SC urging the newly appointed prosecutor to withdraw assault charges relating to an incident involving Northern Territory Administrator David Connolly.

daily.title: Co-pilot attempted to crash plane from Dubai to Tel Aviv, Netanyahu says
daily.summary: Passenger Miryam Shira Ohayon said the plane was "pretty much out of control" when one of the pilots tried to stab the other while they were flying over Jordan en route from Dubai to Tel Aviv.

daily.title: 'Jenni's legacy': Father calls for change after daughter dies with anorexia
daily.summary: The father of a young woman with anorexia nervosa has implored the state government to adopt a coroner's recommendations for improved eating disorder services to spare other families the same grief.

daily.title: Nathan Cleary accepts maiden Dally M Medal from his dad's couch
daily.summary: Injured Penrith superstar Nathan Cleary has claimed his maiden Dally M Medal, with Brisbane fullback Tamika Upton taking the NRLW award for the third time in four seasons.

developing.title: Breaking: Olympic authorities sign off on controversial rowing and canoeing venue
developing.summary: The Fitzroy River in Rockhampton will host the events despite concerns over its current, length and crocodile inhabitants.

developing.summary: Markets are pricing in a nearly 90 per cent chance of Australia's reserve bank lifting interest rates in September following the US Federal Reserve's decision to hike rates.

developing.summary: The federal government has bowed to pressure and scrapped its proposed $5,000 veteran allied health cap announced in this year's federal budget. Follow live.
